titleEn: Master Bathroom Renovation in Vancouver & Burnaby (2026): Real Costs, Design Ideas, and What to Expect
titleZh: 溫哥華及本拿比主臥浴室裝修（2026）：真實費用、設計靈感及完整指南
contentEn:
A master bathroom renovation in Vancouver or Burnaby typically costs between $19,000 and $85,000 in 2026, depending on size, finish level, and scope. A standard 80–120 sq ft master bath renovation — including demolition, plumbing relocation, tile, vanity, fixtures, and labour — averages $30,000–$55,000. A luxury master bath with heated floors, frameless glass, custom millwork, and high-end fixtures can reach $70,000–$100,000 or more. These figures are based on actual project data from renovation permits and real homeowner budgets across Metro Vancouver.

What Does a Master Bathroom Renovation Include?

Unlike a standard bathroom, a master bathroom renovation often involves larger scope: relocatable plumbing for a new layout, structural considerations for wall removal, upgraded ventilation systems, and higher-end finishes throughout. The most common scope items include:

  • Full demolition of existing tile, flooring, and fixtures
  • Plumbing rough-in and drain relocation (if layout changes)
  • New walk-in shower with frameless glass or freestanding soaking tub
  • Double vanity with quartz or natural stone countertop
  • Heated floor installation (radiant in-floor)
  • New toilet (often in a separate water closet)
  • Exhaust fan upgrades to meet BC Building Code
  • Lighting design: recessed pot lights, vanity sconces, accent lighting

Master Bathroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver and Burnaby (2026)

Based on real project data from homeowners in Vancouver and Burnaby, here are typical cost ranges:

ScopeCost Range (CAD)Notes
Mid-range renovation (new tile, vanity, tub)$30,000 – $50,000Same layout; no plumbing relocation
Full renovation with layout change$50,000 – $70,000Plumbing moved; new shower location; water closet added
Luxury master bath (custom millwork, heated floors)$70,000 – $100,000+Premium fixtures; smart toilet; full custom tile

Costs in West Vancouver, Shaughnessy, and Point Grey typically run 15–25% higher than the ranges above due to property values and finish expectations. Most master bathroom renovations take 6–12 weeks of construction after permits are issued.

Do You Need a Permit for a Master Bathroom Renovation in Vancouver?

Most master bathroom renovations in Vancouver and Burnaby require a building permit if they involve plumbing work, electrical upgrades, or structural changes. Key triggers:

  • Moving or adding plumbing fixtures (toilet, shower, sink relocation)
  • Installing a new window or enlarging an existing one
  • Any structural work, including removing or modifying a bearing wall
  • Upgrading electrical panel or adding heated floor circuits

A basic vanity and tile replacement with no plumbing or electrical changes may not require a permit. Always verify with the City of Vancouver or City of Burnaby before starting work.

Popular Master Bathroom Design Trends in Vancouver (2026)

Vancouver homeowners are trending toward spa-inspired master bathroom designs that feel like a retreat. Top trends this year include:

  • Walk-in showers with frameless glass: Curbless or low-threshold showers with 10mm+ frameless glass panels are now standard in luxury renovations. Cost premium: $2,500–$6,000 over a standard framed shower.
  • Freestanding soaking tubs: Japanese-style deep soaking tubs (soaker tubs) are popular as a focal point. Popular brands include MTI and Aquatic. Budget $3,000–$8,000 installed.
  • Double vanity with floating design: A wall-mounted double vanity creates visual spaciousness — a key priority for Vancouver's smaller condo and townhouse master baths.
  • Heated floors: Radiant in-floor heating is now standard in luxury Vancouver master baths. Cost: $1,500–$4,000 depending on floor area.
  • Smart toilets: Toto and Kohler smart toilets with bidet functionality, heated seats, and auto-flush are appearing in high-end Vancouver renovations. Budget $1,500–$4,500 per unit.

How Long Does a Master Bathroom Renovation Take?

A typical master bathroom renovation in Vancouver or Burnaby takes 6–12 weeks of active construction, plus 4–8 weeks for permit processing if required. The full timeline from project start to final inspection:

  • Design and quoting: 2–4 weeks
  • Permit application and processing: 4–8 weeks (City of Vancouver) / 2–4 weeks (City of Burnaby)
  • Demolition: 3–5 days
  • Plumbing and electrical rough-in: 5–10 days
  • Tiling and waterproofing: 5–10 days
  • Finish work (vanity, fixtures, glass): 3–7 days
  • Final inspection: 1 day

Key feedback from real reviews includes: clear communication about budget, realistic timelines, and professional handling of any mid-project discoveries such as water damage or outdated plumbing.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a master bathroom renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A master bathroom renovation in Vancouver typically costs $30,000–$55,000 for a mid-range project and $70,000–$100,000+ for a luxury renovation. The final cost depends on whether plumbing is relocated, the grade of finishes selected, and whether structural work is involved.

Do I need a permit to renovate my master bathroom in Vancouver?

You need a building permit if your master bathroom renovation involves moving plumbing fixtures, upgrading electrical circuits, or any structural work. A simple vanity and tile replacement without plumbing changes may not require a permit. Check with the City of Vancouver or City of Burnaby before starting.

How long does a master bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

Active construction typically takes 6–12 weeks after permits are issued. Permit processing adds another 4–8 weeks in Vancouver and 2–4 weeks in Burnaby. A realistic total project timeline is 10–20 weeks from start to final inspection.

What is the average size of a master bathroom in Vancouver?

Master bathrooms in Vancouver condos and townhouses typically range from 60 to 120 square feet. Detached homes in Vancouver and Burnaby often have larger master baths ranging from 100 to 200+ square feet. Larger spaces can accommodate both a walk-in shower and a freestanding tub.

What is the best flooring for a Vancouver master bathroom?

Porcelain tile and heated radiant floors are the most popular choice for Vancouver master bathrooms because they handle humidity well and provide warmth in winter. Large-format porcelain tiles (24"x24" or larger) create a clean, spacious look and reduce grout lines. Natural stone such as marble or slate is also popular in luxury renovations but requires more maintenance.
contentZh:
溫哥華及本拿比的主臥浴室裝修在2026年的典型費用為19,000至85,000加元，具體取決於面積、裝修等級和工程範圍。80至120平方英尺的標準主臥浴室裝修（包括拆除、管道搬遷瓷磚、浴室櫃、裝置和人工）平均為30,000至55,000加元。配有地暖、無框玻璃、定制細木工和高檔裝置的豪華主臥浴室可達70,000至100,000加元以上。這些數據基於大溫哥華地區的裝修許可證和業主預算的實際項目數據。

主臥浴室裝修包括哪些內容？

與標準浴室不同，主臥浴室裝修通常涉及更大的範圍：為新佈局搬遷管道、牆壁拆除的結構考慮、升級通風系統以及全屋更高檔的裝修。最常見的工程項目包括：

  • 拆除現有瓷磚、地板和裝置
  • 管道粗裝和排水搬遷（如佈局更改）
  • 新步入式淋浴間，帶無框玻璃或獨立浸泡浴缸
  • 雙人浴室櫃，配石英或天然石材台面
  • 地暖安裝（輻射地暖）
  • 新馬桶（通常在獨立的水廁中）
  • 排氣扇升級至BC建築規範標準
  • 照明設計：嵌入式筒燈、梳妝檯壁燈、重點照明

2026年溫哥華及本拿比主臥浴室裝修費用

基於溫哥華和本拿比業主的實際項目數據，以下是典型費用範圍：

工程範圍費用範圍（加元）備註
中等裝修（新瓷磚、浴室櫃、浴缸）$30,000 – $50,000相同佈局；無管道搬遷
全屋裝修帶佈局更改$50,000 – $70,000管道搬遷；新淋浴位置；新增水廁
豪華主臥浴室（定制細木工、地暖）$70,000 – $100,000+高檔裝置；智能馬桶；全屋定制瓷磚

西溫哥華、Shaughnessy和Point Grey的費用通常比上述範圍高15-25%，這是由於房產價值和裝修預期較高。大多數主臥浴室裝修在許可證簽發後需要6-12週的施工時間。

溫哥華主臥浴室裝修需要許可證嗎？

溫哥華和本拿比的大多數主臥浴室裝修如果涉及管道工程、電氣升級或結構更改，則需要建築許可證。主要觸發條件包括：

  • 搬遷或添加管道裝置（馬桶、淋浴間、洗臉盆搬遷）
  • 安裝新窗戶或擴大現有窗戶
  • 任何結構工作，包括拆除或修改承重牆
  • 升級電錶或新增地暖電路

如果沒有管道或電氣更改，簡單的浴室櫃和瓷磚更換可能不需要許可證。在開工前務必向溫哥華市或本拿比市確認。

2026年溫哥華主臥浴室設計趨勢

溫哥華業主越來越傾向於水療風格的主臥浴室設計，讓感覺像一個度假勝地。今年的主要趨勢包括：

  • 帶無框玻璃的步入式淋浴間：無障礙或低門檻淋浴間，配10毫米以上無框玻璃面板，現在已成為豪華裝修的標準。成本溢價：比標準框架淋浴間高2,500至6,000加元。
  • 獨立浸泡浴缸：日式深浸泡浴缸作為焦點越來越受歡迎。流行品牌包括MTI和Aquatic。預算3,000至8,000加元（含安裝）。
  • 浮式雙人浴室櫃：牆裝雙人浴室櫃創造視覺空間感——這是溫哥華較小的公寓和聯排別墅主臥浴室的關鍵優先事項。
  • 地暖：輻射地暖現在是溫哥華豪華主臥浴室的標準配置。成本：根據地面面積1,500至4,000加元。
  • 智能馬桶：Toto和Kohler智能馬桶，具有沖洗功能、加熱座圈和自動沖水功能，正出現在溫哥華高端裝修中。每台預算1,500至4,500加元。

主臥浴室裝修需要多長時間？

溫哥華或本拿比典型的主臥浴室裝修需要6-12週的 active construction，另有4-8週的許可證處理時間（如需要）。從項目開工到最終檢查的完整時間表：

  • 設計和報價：2-4週
  • 許可證申請和處理：4-8週（溫哥華市）/ 2-4週（本拿比市）
  • 拆除：3-5天
  • 管道和電氣粗裝：5-10天
  • 瓷磚和防水：5-10天
  • 裝修工作（浴室櫃、裝置、玻璃）：3-7天
  • 最終檢查：1天

常見問題

2026年溫哥華主臥浴室裝修的平均費用是多少？

溫哥華主臥浴室裝修的中等項目通常為30,000至55,000加元，豪華裝修為70,000至100,000加元以上。最終費用取決於是否搬遷管道、選擇的裝修等級以及是否有結構工程。

在溫哥華裝修主臥浴室需要許可證嗎？

如果您的主臥浴室裝修涉及搬遷管道裝置、升級電氣電路或任何結構工程，則需要建築許可證。如果沒有管道或電氣更改，簡單的浴室櫃和瓷磚更換可能不需要許可證。在開工前向溫哥華市或本拿比市確認。

溫哥華主臥浴室裝修需要多長時間？

施工通常在許可證簽發後需要6-12週。許可證處理在溫哥華額外增加4-8週，在本拿比增加2-4週。現實的項目總時間為開工到最終檢查10-20週。

溫哥華主臥浴室的平均面積是多少？

溫哥華公寓和聯排別墅的主臥浴室通常為60至120平方英尺。溫哥華和本拿比的獨立住宅的主臥浴室通常為100至200+平方英尺。較大的空間可以同時容納步入式淋浴間和獨立浴缸。

溫哥華主臥浴室的最佳地板是什麼？

瓷磚和輻射地暖是溫哥華主臥浴室最受歡迎的選擇，因為它們能很好地處理濕度並在冬季提供溫暖。大規格瓷磚（24英寸x 24英寸或更大）營造簡潔、寬敞的外觀並減少瓷磚線。天然石材（如大理石或片岩）在豪華裝修中也很受歡迎，但需要更多維護。
